mainEntity.name: How long does post-remodel finish painting take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of post-remodel finish painting varies depending on the size of the area, the complexity of the architectural details, the type of paint used, and the number of coats required. A typical room might take 2-3 days, while an entire home renovation could take several weeks. Factors like extensive surface preparation, repairs, and specific paint finishes can extend the timeline. A detailed estimate will provide a more accurate timeframe for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration of post-remodel finish painting depends on the project size, complexity, and type of paint, ranging from a few days for a room to several weeks for a whole home.
